links.outcome: Perceived understanding (pre/post change) and ratings of ease, clarity, and comprehensibility among lay participants
links.effect: Group×time interaction on perceived understanding: insomnia F1,498=24.8, P<.001; nicotine dependence F1,498=14.1, P<.001; simplified rated easier, clearer, more comprehensible (all P<.05), r=0.11-0.24
links.quote: Compared with manufacturer-provided original materials, LLM-simplified DTx explanations led to greater improvements in perceived understanding and subjective evaluations of readability among lay audiences, even after a single exposure.

design_hint: LLM reading-level simplification of patient education materials
